# tools/tests/fixtures/translit_empty_by_rule.txt — Session 18 D2.

# Lemmas whose EGYPTOLOGICAL transliteration is the empty string BY RULE.
# The Egyptological scheme (translit.py U5) strips Greek vowels (a e ē o ō)
# and keeps only consonants; a vowel-only lemma therefore has no consonantal
# skeleton. That is the scheme working, not the feature missing: the other
# four schemes are non-empty for every line here, and no other shard entry
# may hold an empty value in any scheme (enforced by test_translit.py).
# One lemma per line; the comment names why the skeleton is empty.
ⲁ # sole vowel a -> stripped, nothing remains
ⲉ̅ # e + overline (numeral/grammatical mark, R4-stripped) -> empty
ⲉⲱ # e + ō -> both stripped
ⲏ︦ # ē + combining mark (R4-stripped) -> empty
ⲟ̄ # o + macron (R4-stripped) -> empty
ⲱ # ō -> stripped
ⲱⲉ # ō + e -> both stripped
ⲱⲱ # ō + ō -> both stripped
